lock — 4 ms aperture click with a tiny metallic ring + short sub thump

word — a breath of air travelling L→R with the wipe

brief: The intro opens on a solid field of Physiofit BlueDark. A circular aperture closes — fast in the middle, soft at both ends — revealing clean paper, and locks exactly as the round head of the P with a precise click and a sub thump while a glassy open chord blooms. The stem grows out of the head, the foot steps in, PHYSIOFIT wipes in from the mark, the frame settles a touch, holds, and fades to paper at 2.5s.
